title: beatmatching with sync
system_instruction_addendum: BEATMATCH SYNC ADDENDUM: Sync is the modern fast-path — press it and the BPMs match. Frame it as a tool, not a shortcut. The ear-version still matters for hardware without sync.

tutor_speak.text: sync is the button that locks deck b's bpm to deck a. modern decks have it; older ones do not.
press sync on deck b — the bpm display jumps to match deck a.

hints.text: the sync button sits in the transport row, near play and cue.
press it once — the deck snaps to deck a's tempo.
press the sync button on deck b now.
